UnusedMissingDaughterText:
Oh, no. Oh, no…

My daughter is
missing.

No… She couldn't
have gone to the BURNED TOWER.

I told her not to
go near it…

People seem to
disappear there…

Oh, what should I
do…?
EcruteakCityGramps1Text:
ECRUTEAK used to
have two towers:

one each in the
east and west.
EcruteakCityGramps2Text:
Ah, child.
Have you learned

to dance like the
KIMONO GIRLS?

If you go to their
DANCE THEATER, an

odd old man will
give you something nice, I hear.
EcruteakCityLass1Text:
I'm going to prac-
tice at the DANCE

THEATER. Care to
join me?
EcruteakCityLass2Text:
The tower that
used to be here…

My grandma told me
it used to be much taller.
EcruteakCityLass2Text_ReleasedBeasts:
Three big #MON
ran off in differ- ent directions. What were they?
EcruteakCityFisherText:
I heard a rumor
about OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE.

The #MON that
serves as the

beacon fell ill.
Sounds like they are in trouble.
EcruteakCityFisherText_JasmineReturned:
The #MON at
OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE has been cured.

Boats can safely
sail out to sea at night again.
EcruteakCityYoungsterText:
I hear #MON are
rampaging at the

LAKE OF RAGE. I'd
like to see that.
EcruteakCityGramps3Text:
In the distant
past…

This tower burned
in a fire. Three

nameless #MON
perished in it.

A rainbow-colored
#MON descended

from the sky and
resurrected them…

It's a legend that
has been passed

down by ECRUTEAK
GYM LEADERS.

Me?

I was a trainer
way back when. Hohoho!
EcruteakCitySignText:
ECRUTEAK CITY
A Historical City

Where the Past
Meets the Present
TinTowerSignText:
TIN TOWER

A legendary #-
MON is said to roost here.
EcruteakGymSignText:
ECRUTEAK CITY
#MON GYM LEADER: MORTY

The Mystic Seer of
the Future
BurnedTowerSignText:
BURNED TOWER

It was destroyed
by a mysterious fire.

Please stay away,
as it is unsafe.
